data.body:
Landed as Gerrit change 3113 (commit fedf819b2d2; LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved, no advisories), after 3112. make verify before the push: 17 failed, 19747 passed; all 17 failures are the known pandoc set under tests/unit/reconciler, none elsewhere, 0 ERROR lines.

What changed: CONTRIBUTING.md section 2e no longer says there is no landing bot; both it and docs/gerrit-aws-setup.md section 6a now say a Contributors member runs Submit, that on the shared agent setup this is RebarBotNava (Submit, no gate label), and that LLM-Review comes from the review bot and Verified from the CI bot. AGENTS.md gains one clause: Submit needs a Contributors-member credential, and scripts/gerrit_safe_submit.py uses whatever git credential fill returns for the Gerrit host, so the script pins no identity. No Gerrit access change was made.

Checks on merged main (HEAD fedf819b2d2), 2026-10-25 14:36 PDT:
1. grep -n 'no landing bot' CONTRIBUTING.md prints nothing (exit 1); RebarBotNava appears in CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/gerrit-aws-setup.md (1 each); CONTRIBUTING.md names the review bot and CI bot.
2. git diff 47e431de04a HEAD --stat -- infra/gerrit is empty, so label permissions and the two submit requirements are unchanged.
3. grep -n Contributors AGENTS.md shows the new clause at line 502; git diff 47e431de04a HEAD --stat -- scripts/gerrit_safe_submit.py is empty.

[non-codebase] criterion, live Gerrit queried 2026-10-25 14:36 PDT (environment production Gerrit rebar.solutions.navateam.com; principal RebarBotNava via git credential fill; instrument live-call). Gerrit reports UTC; PDT is 7 hours earlier. All 5 changes below are MERGED with owner and submitter RebarBotNava, LLM-Review +1 only from rebar-review-bot and Verified +1 only from rebar-ci-bot:
- 3109 submitted 08:16 PDT
- 3110 submitted 09:20 PDT
- 3111 submitted 10:48 PDT
- 3112 submitted 14:35 PDT
- 3113 submitted 14:35 PDT
No administrator credential was involved.

Unverified: rebar-review-bot's own ability to Submit was not tested and is not needed; the decision of 2026-10-25 keeps that grant out. Splitting the vote permissions between the two service accounts stays out of scope.
